metadata.description: Email addresses that receive the report, as a JSON array. Example: ["ops@contoso.com","team@contoso.com"]
Subscription IDs to check, as a JSON array. Defaults to the deployment subscription. Grant the Logic App identity Reader on each one.
Report sizes that are retired or retire within this many months.
Name of the Office 365 Outlook connection. Authorize it after deployment.
Region for the Logic App and the connection.
Keep Disabled until the Office 365 connection is authorized.
Grant the Logic App identity Reader on the deployment subscription. Requires Owner or User Access Administrator.

Risk_query.inputs:
// Retirement dates: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-machines/sizes/lifecycle/retirements-and-capacity-restrictions
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets'
| extend Sku = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), tostring(sku.name))
| extend k = toupper(Sku), loc = tolower(location)
| extend n = toint(extract('^[A-Z]+_[A-Z]+([0-9]+)', 1, k)), c = extract('^[A-Z]+_[A-Z]+[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)', 1, k)
| extend f = case(
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_DS?(1|2|3|4|5|11|12|13|14|15)(-[0-9]+)?(_V2)?(_PROMO)?$', 'D',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_D[0-9]+S?_V3$', 'Dv3',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_E64IS?_V3$', 'Ev3i',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_E[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?S?_V3$', 'Ev3',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_A[0-9]+_V2$', 'Av2',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_A[0-9]+M_V2$', 'Amv2',
    k matches regex '^(BASIC|STANDARD)_A[0-7]$', 'Av1',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_B[0-9]+[A-Z]+[0-9]?$', 'Bv1',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_F[0-9]+S?(_V2)?$', 'F',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_GS?[0-9](-[0-9]+)?$', 'G',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_L[0-9]+S$', 'Ls',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_L[0-9]+S_V2$', 'Lsv2',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_M192ID?M?S_V2$', 'Msv2',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_DC[0-9]+S?_V2$', 'DCsv2',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_DC[0-9]+A?D?S_CC_V5$', 'DCcc',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_EC[0-9]+A?D?S_CC_V5$', 'ECcc',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_DC[0-9]+D?S_V3$', 'DCsv3',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_NC(6|12|24|24R)(_PROMO)?$', 'NC',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_NC(6|12|24)R?S_V2$', 'NCv2',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_NC(6|12|24)R?S_V3$', 'NCv3',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_ND(6|12|24)R?S$', 'ND',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_NV(6|12|24)(_PROMO)?$', 'NV',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_NV[0-9]+[HM]?S_V3$', 'NVv3',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_NV[0-9]+AH?S_V4$', 'NVv4',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_NP(10|20|40)S$', 'NP',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_H(8|16)M?R?(_PROMO)?$', 'H',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_HC44(-[0-9]+)?RS$', 'HC',
    k matches regex '^STANDARD_HB120(-[0-9]+)?RS_V2$', 'HBv2',
    '')
| where isnotempty(f)
| extend RetireOn = case(
    f in ('D', 'Ls'), datetime(2028-05-01),
    f in ('Av2', 'Amv2', 'Bv1', 'F', 'G', 'Lsv2'), datetime(2028-11-15),
    f in ('Dv3', 'Ev3', 'Ev3i') and not(loc matches regex '^(usgov|usdod|usnat|ussec|china)'), datetime(2029-11-15),
    f == 'DCsv3', datetime(2029-10-31),
    f == 'Msv2', datetime(2027-03-31),
    f in ('NP', 'HC', 'HBv2'), datetime(2027-05-31),
    f == 'NVv3' and loc == 'uaenorth', datetime(2027-01-31),
    f in ('NVv3', 'NVv4'), datetime(2026-09-30),
    f in ('DCcc', 'ECcc'), datetime(2026-09-01),
    f == 'DCsv2', datetime(2026-06-30),
    f == 'NCv3' and loc in ('usgovvirginia', 'usgovarizona'), datetime(2026-12-31),
    f == 'NCv3' and loc in ('jioindiawest', 'chinanorth3'), datetime(2027-06-30),
    f == 'NCv3', datetime(2025-09-30),
    f == 'Av1', datetime(2024-08-31),
    f in ('NC', 'NCv2', 'ND', 'NV'), datetime(2023-09-06),
    f == 'H', datetime(2022-08-31),
    datetime(null))
| where RetireOn <= datetime_add('month', @{parameters('retirementHorizonMonths')}, startofday(now()))
| extend v = case(f == 'D' and n < 10, toint(pow(2, n - 1)), f == 'D' and n == 15, 20, f == 'D', toint(pow(2, n - 10)), f == 'G', toint(pow(2, n)), n)
| extend Recommended = case(
    f == 'D' and n < 10, strcat('Standard_D', max_of(v, 2), 'ds_v5'),
    f == 'D', strcat('Standard_E', v, c, 'ds_v5'),
    f == 'Dv3', strcat('Standard_D', n, 'ds_v5'),
    f == 'Ev3i', iff(k contains 'IS_', 'Standard_E104ids_v5', 'Standard_E104id_v5'),
    f == 'Ev3', strcat('Standard_E', n, c, 'ds_v5'),
    f == 'Av2', strcat('Standard_D', max_of(n, 2), 'd_v5'),
    f == 'Amv2', strcat('Standard_E', n, 'd_v5'),
    f == 'Av1', 'Bsv2, Ddv5 or Edv5',
    f == 'Bv1', case(
        k in ('STANDARD_B1LS', 'STANDARD_B1LS2', 'STANDARD_B1S'), 'Standard_B2ts_v2',
        k in ('STANDARD_B1MS', 'STANDARD_B2S'), 'Standard_B2ls_v2',
        k == 'STANDARD_B2MS', 'Standard_B2s_v2',
        k == 'STANDARD_B4MS', 'Standard_B4s_v2',
        k == 'STANDARD_B8MS', 'Standard_B8s_v2',
        k in ('STANDARD_B12MS', 'STANDARD_B16MS'), 'Standard_B16s_v2',
        k == 'STANDARD_B20MS', 'Standard_B32s_v2',
        'Bsv2'),
    f == 'F', strcat('Standard_D', iff(n > 64, 96, max_of(n, 2)), 'lds_v5'),
    f == 'G', strcat('Standard_L', max_of(v * 2, 8), 's_v3'),
    f == 'Ls', strcat('Standard_L', max_of(n, 8), 's_v3'),
    f == 'Lsv2', strcat('Standard_L', n, 's_v3'),
    f == 'Msv2', 'Msv3 or Mdsv3 Medium Memory',
    f == 'DCsv2', 'DCdsv3, DCasv6 or DCesv6',
    f == 'DCcc', 'Dasv5/Dadsv5 or DCasv6',
    f == 'ECcc', 'Easv5/Eadsv5 or ECasv6',
    f == 'DCsv3', 'DCasv6/DCadsv6 or DCesv6/DCedsv6',
    f == 'NC', case(n == 6, 'Standard_NC4as_T4_v3', n == 12, 'Standard_NC16as_T4_v3', 'Standard_NC64as_T4_v3'),
    f == 'NCv2', case(n == 6, 'Standard_NC24ads_A100_v4', n == 12, 'Standard_NC48ads_A100_v4', 'Standard_NC96ads_A100_v4'),
    f == 'NCv3', 'NCadsH100_v5',
    f == 'ND', case(n == 6, 'Standard_NC4as_T4_v3', n == 12, 'Standard_NC16as_T4_v3', k == 'STANDARD_ND24RS', 'Standard_ND96amsr_A100_v4', 'Standard_NC64as_T4_v3'),
    f in ('NV', 'NVv3'), 'NVadsA10_v5',
    f == 'NVv4', 'NVads_V710_v5',
    f == 'NP', case(n == 10, 'Standard_NC4as_T4_v3', n == 20, 'Standard_NC16as_T4_v3', 'Standard_NC64as_T4_v3'),
    f in ('H', 'HC', 'HBv2'), 'HBv4, HBv5 or HX',
    '')
| extend Days = datetime_diff('day', RetireOn, startofday(now()))
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId
| project
    Status = iff(Days <= 0, 'Retired', strcat('Retires in ', Days, iff(Days == 1, ' day', ' days'))),
    RetirementDate = substring(tostring(RetireOn), 0, 10),
    SubscriptionId = subscriptionId,
    SubscriptionName,
    ResourceGroup = resourceGroup,
    ResourceName = name,
    Type = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'VM', strcat('VMSS (', tostring(toint(sku.capacity)), ')')),
    Sku,
    RecommendedSku = Recommended,
    Region = location,
    Days
| order by Days asc, SubscriptionName asc, ResourceGroup asc, ResourceName asc
| project-away Days

Email_table.inputs:
@replace(replace(replace(replace(body('Risk_table'), '', '
'), '', ''), '
', ''), 'RetiredRetired', '')

body.Subject: Azure VM retirement: @{length(outputs('Risky_resources'))} VMs or scale sets need action
body.Body:
@{length(outputs('Risky_resources'))} VMs or scale sets use sizes that are retired or retire within @{parameters('retirementHorizonMonths')} months. Resize or migrate them before the retirement date.

@{outputs('Email_table')}

Scanned @{sub(length(parameters('subscriptionIds')), length(body('Unreadable_subscriptions')))} of @{length(parameters('subscriptionIds'))} subscriptions@{if(greater(int(coalesce(body('Find_risky_VMs')?['totalRecords'], 0)), length(outputs('Risky_resources'))), concat('; showing the first ', string(length(outputs('Risky_resources'))), ' of ', string(body('Find_risky_VMs')?['totalRecords'])), '')}. Recommended sizes keep the vCPU and memory class; validate disks, images and quota before resizing. Retirement dates and guidance

runError.message: The Logic App identity has no Reader access to: @{join(body('Unreadable_subscriptions'), ', ')}

postDeploymentSteps.value: 1) Open the Office 365 connection > Edit API connection > Authorize > Save. 2) Grant the Logic App identity Reader on every other subscription in subscriptionIds. 3) Enable the Logic App. It runs every other Monday at 09:00 (Turkey Standard Time).
